optimization-iteration.name: rss-parse-without-owned-line
optimization-iteration.rationale: Parse RSS directly from the already-read status buffer, eliminating the allocated copied line without changing sampling frequency or reported units.
optimization-iteration.phase_basis: Historical and preceding per-game profiles show IPC/serialization/hash/validation allocations on measured path; candidate targets supervisor sampling
optimization-iteration.patch: diff --git a/tools/bot-evaluation/src/runtime_identity.rs b/tools/bot-evaluation/src/runtime_identity.rs index 07245189..34787469 100644 --- a/tools/bot-evaluation/src/runtime_identity.rs +++ b/tools/bot-evaluation/src/runtime_identity.rs @@ -32,16 +32,7 @@ pub(crate) fn hardware() -> Value { pub(crate) fn rss(pid: u32) -> u64 { fs::read_to_string(format!("/proc/{pid}/status")) .ok() - .and_then(|s| { - s.lines() - .find(|l| l.starts_with("VmRSS:")) - .map(str::to_owned) - }) - .and_then(|s| { - s.split_whitespace() - .nth(1) - .and_then(|s| s.parse::<u64>().ok()) - }) + .and_then(|s| s.lines().find_map(|line| line.strip_prefix("VmRSS:").and_then(|value| value.split_whitespace().next()?.parse::<u64>().ok()))) .unwrap_or(0) * 1024 }
